adjacent.text: The 3Q26 deck (published 2026-10-14) shows GWIM net income of $1,540 million ("Net income $1.5B; ROAC 28%"), a pretax margin of 29% and return on average allocated capital of 28. The 3Q26 supplement shows GWIM nine-month 2026 net income of $4,282 million.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 2Q26 deck (published 2026-07-14) shows GWIM net income of $1,413 million, a pretax margin of 27% and ROAC of 26. The 10-Q for 2Q26 (published 2026-07-31) gives a six-month GWIM operating margin of 27 percent compared to 22 percent a year ago.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 2025 10-K (published 2026-02-25) states that GWIM net income increased $407 million to $4.7 billion, the operating margin was 25 percent in both 2025 and 2024, and the return on average allocated capital was 24 percent, up from 23 percent.
adjacent.differs_because: GWIM includes both Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank; the two have different reporting scopes, so GWIM figures are not Merrill's.

adjacent.text: The 10-Q for 2Q26 (published 2026-07-31) reports Merrill Wealth Management revenue of $5.7 billion, up 16 percent. The 2025 10-K reports Merrill Wealth Management revenue of $20.7 billion, up nine percent.
adjacent.differs_because: These are revenue figures for the Merrill Wealth Management business line, not profit measures such as net income or margin; no profitability is given for it separately.

gaps.what: Merrill does not report standalone results.
gaps.suggested_source: Bank of America 10-K/10-Q segment disclosures (GWIM) or investor-day materials; Merrill-level net income, margin and ROAC are not broken out in these filings.
